_what: Non-secret site configuration. Every field is OPTIONAL. When a field is set the template renders its markup; when it is empty the template renders NOTHING AT ALL, not an empty placeholder, because markup that lies about being configured is worse than markup that is absent.
_not_secrets: The Cloudflare beacon token ships in client-side HTML on every page by design, and the two verification tokens are meta tags a crawler reads. None of these is a credential. Nothing that IS a credential belongs in this file.
